desc:
You spent your last Coins on a warehouse packed with unclaimed cargo. It seemed like an easy profit—until you discovered just how many boxes were waiting inside...

Can you unbox everything, recover the Coins you spent, and uncover what the abandoned cargo is hiding?

How to play:
📦 Unbox all the cargo before time runs out
💰 Deposit valuable items and recover your Coins
🛠️ Buy and upgrade tools to work faster
⚙️ Build conveyors and automate your warehouse
👥 Team up with friends to finish together
🔍 Discover rare items and complete your collection

Tags: unboxing, boxes, cargo, warehouse, automation, conveyor, simulator, adventure, mystery, secret, co-op, multiplayer, teamwork, collection.
